mathematical_review.basis_coordinates: For a unitary U with the chosen full eigenbasis as columns, the physical coordinate transform is (U†⊗I) Q (U⊗I). The physical order is (X,Y), the restoring order is s,(X,Y), and the column order is (s,e),(X,Y).
mathematical_review.factor_permutation: The map ((s,e),(x,y)) ↦ ((s,(x,y)),e) has the direction used by the matrix submatrix pullback. Transporting R0⊗Ie therefore places Ie in the second ancillary factor of its Gram matrix.
mathematical_review.dagger_orientation: The checked quantities are R0†R0 and B0†B0, never the reversed products. Output-basis orthogonality removes unequal ancillary indices. The physical product is [Q(|x⟩⟨b|⊗T)]† Q(|x⟩⟨b|⊗T), giving |b⟩⟨b|⊗T⟨x|Q|x⟩T.
mathematical_review.arbitrary_blanks: The blank factors are |b⟩⟨b| for arbitrary b. They need not be unit vectors, eigenvectors or projections; zero blanks are allowed. No normalization is silently used in the Gram identities.
mathematical_review.weights_and_full_basis: Only p_x for x in E must be positive. The inverse square-root coefficient squares to p_x^-1 on E. The second column sum runs over the entire chosen basis, including zero-probability coordinates, and produces IX, not a selected-support projector.
mathematical_review.weaker_gram_contracts: The Gram identities require Q†=Q, Q²=Q and T†=T. They do not require T²=T or commutation of Q with IX⊗T. Positivity of BY alone requires Q≥0 and T†=T, because each summand is a positive scalar multiple of a Hermitian congruence of the positive compression ⟨x|Q|x⟩.
mathematical_review.partial_trace: PartialTraceRight traces Y in the (X,Y) basis. Cyclicity holds for arbitrary A and T on the traced factor. Projection compression uses T†=T and T²=T. Splitting with I-T proves the partial-trace order bound without requiring A to commute with IX⊗T.
mathematical_review.actual_marginal_order: The defined matrix is MX=trY((IX⊗T)ρQ), not an abstract positive matrix supplied as an assumption. With ρ≥0, Q and T orthogonal projections, and ρQ=Qρ, A=ρQ obeys 0≤A≤ρ. Partial-trace cyclicity inserts the right-hand K=IX⊗T, yielding 0≤MX=trY(KAK)≤trY A≤trY ρ. No Q/K commutation is assumed.
mathematical_review.support_inverse: From 0≤M≤ρ, ker ρ is contained in ker M and both support absorptions follow. The support-inverse normalization lies below Pρ. Expanding the two positive congruences using ρ+ρρ+=ρ+ gives M-Mρ+M≥0, without full rank or M/ρ commutation.
